sceneDescription: Fanteena ta birowser’ik Heliya node awlissa. Diifule anxax nodes awayyih uddur birooserit axawah taniih gude fan firta le. Vaylet nodes geytimteh birowser gital takkay immay garayte wayte. Dahab nodes fakut tan angaaraw gabbaaqul baxsa le dariifah Kubo daemon; oson birowser angaaraw hinnon kee ta fanteena fan firta malon. rabe cutuuka garuq le aydaadu dacrissaah, ken sumaaqih firti angaaraw garuq geera dubuk duugumele. Fanti kartak baxxo qeedaalisso udurrutte; acassaale sinni fiqma tabbixeh iroh orbit, kee buttaati gonah wagitte merraytu. Bilsiyyi aydaadi cutuuka fiqma matawlissa. qaku le iroh orbit asta culte Kuboh booxal kee angaaraw hinna. Tabaatabsi exxa tanbulleem dubuk tabaatabsi mamaxxaga tanbulle wak tanbulle fiqma koboxul; annaak yan fiqma-fanah-fiqma topolooji qigdu maqaddoosinna. kutbe cibtal inkibisle oytah fiqma kusaaqiset xoqoysima.
